source_snapshot.test_name: Type 39 - System Power Supply - Cooling Device Handle
source_snapshot.items: Type 39 - System Power Supply - Cooling Device Handle
source_snapshot.procedure: Check the test-item information, collect evidence and confirm it remains correct after reboot.
source_snapshot.criteria: Information is correct and remains correct after reboot.
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: DeepSeek greps the handle value but does not retain the Type 39 record identity/length, resolve it to Type 27, define no-device handling or perform the required reboot comparison.

original_test_intent.purpose: Verify that each applicable SMBIOS Type 39 System Power Supply Cooling Device Handle is structurally present when required, resolves to the intended Type 27 Cooling Device or approved no-device value, and remains correct after reboot.
original_test_intent.target: Every Type 39 record required by the platform PSU topology and its offset-12h Cooling Device Handle when the record length includes that field, mapped to the associated Type 27 handle or the specification/owner-approved no-device representation.
original_test_intent.scope: Read-only Type 39-to-Type 27 reference integrity before and after one approved reboot. BMC fan sensors and telemetry may corroborate health but do not substitute for the SMBIOS handle relationship.
original_test_intent.operation: Capture complete Type 27/39 structures, SUT/PSU topology and BMC health, validate Type 39 length before reading offset 12h, resolve every non-no-device handle to an existing Type 27 record and owner PSU association, obtain reboot approval, repeat and compare all references plus platform health.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: Two complete read-only reference checks separated by one approved reboot; no PSU manipulation, fan override or thermal workload.
original_test_intent.expected_result: Every applicable Type 39 reference is either an owner-approved no-device value or resolves to the correct Type 27 cooling record without dangling/invalid association; all mappings persist after reboot and PSU/fan/thermal/host management health remains normal.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: SUT/BIOS/BMC/SMBIOS/dmidecode identity, complete pre/post Type 27/39 raw structures with lengths/handles, owner PSU-to-cooling/no-device/shared map, resolution table, reboot timeline and supplemental read-only PSU/fan/thermal/BMC health.
ambiguities: The source gives no PSU-to-Type 27 association or no-device/shared-cooling policy.
It does not state how to treat Type 39 records too short to contain offset 12h on the SUT's SMBIOS version.
The procedure omits the explicit reboot required by the criterion.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly treats this as a cross-structure reference, checks structure length, resolves Type 39 to Type 27, allows owner-defined shared/no-device topology, keeps telemetry supplemental and prohibits cooling changes. No material technical or safety correction is required.

applicable_history.decision: The historical review retains only the Type 39 grep fragment and delegates correctness/persistence without resolving Type 27.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Keep V2. The check is automatable after owner topology and package/access are supplied, while reboot is approval-gated. Actual Type 27/39 structures and health telemetry can be collected safely before acceptance data exists.

available_now: DMTF defines Type 39 offset 12h as a handle of an associated Type 27 Cooling Device; Type 27 describes a single cooling device and its status/type.
Complete Type 27/39 actual structures and read-only BMC cooling health can be collected before the owner topology is supplied.
V2 already distinguishes handle integrity from active fan-control testing and forbids writes.
missing_inputs: Expected Type 39 PSU records and per-PSU Type 27 association, including shared-cooling and no-device policy for the SUT's SMBIOS version
Platform PSU topology and stable identity mapping between Type 39 location/device/serial and physical/BMC PSU inventory
Validated dmidecode/raw parser, sudo/host access, approved reboot window/workload isolation, stable power and OOB recovery
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The platform/power/BIOS owner supplies the PSU-to-cooling topology and no-device policy; the lab/system owner supplies validated tooling/access and approves the reboot/recovery window.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Collect SMBIOS/dmidecode versions and complete Type 27/39 structures with raw lengths/handles without filtering or clearing logs
Build a provisional Type 39 PSU identity/length/cooling-handle to Type 27 resolution table and collect supplemental read-only BMC PSU/fan/thermal status, reporting actuals without PASS
prohibited_until_closed: Do not declare PASS from a numeric handle, dereference a field absent by structure length, treat a BMC sensor as proof of an SMBIOS link or reject shared/no-device values without owner/version policy
Do not remove/load-share PSUs, change fan modes/thresholds, clear logs or reboot without approval, stable power and OOB recovery
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: The signed PSU map accounts for every applicable Type 39 record, structure length, no-device/shared policy and expected Type 27 association; parser/access are validated; reboot/recovery are approved; the same complete mapping can run pre/post reboot.

revision_candidate.test_name: SMBIOS Type 39 Cooling Device Handle Persistence
revision_candidate.purpose: Verify every applicable System Power Supply Cooling Device Handle resolves to the correct Type 27 Cooling Device or approved no-device representation and persists after reboot.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The exact server PSU/cooling topology and BIOS/SMBIOS build with an owner-approved association map, validated dmidecode/raw parser, host access, an approved reboot window and BMC/OOB recovery.
revision_candidate.target_scope: All platform-required Type 39 records whose structure length includes offset 12h, linked to Type 27 handles or an approved no-device value. BMC telemetry is supplemental, not a replacement relationship.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: PSU-to-Type 27/no-device/shared map; Type 39 PSU identity mapping; SMBIOS/version-aware length semantics; dmidecode/parser and sudo access; reboot approval, workload isolation, stable power, OOB recovery and evidence destination.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Collect complete pre-reboot Type 27/39 structures; verify Type 39 lengths; map every PSU identity and resolve each cooling handle under the signed policy; collect read-only health corroboration; after explicit approval reboot once; repeat and compare all mappings and health.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Correct SUT/BIOS/PSU recipe selected; complete association policy signed; parser and access validated; adequate PSU redundancy/stable power confirmed for ordinary reboot; workload quiesced; OOB recovery ready; logs preserved.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Signed topology/policy; platform/tool/SMBIOS identity; unfiltered pre/post Type 27/39 structures; lengths and raw handles; PSU-to-cooling resolution table; supplemental BMC PSU/fan/thermal status; reboot timeline; OS/BMC health and exceptions.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: DMTF DSP0134 SMBIOS Type 39 offset-12h and Type 27 semantics for the implemented SMBIOS version, plus the exact platform PSU/cooling topology specification.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Use read-only SMBIOS and telemetry collection only. Do not change fan/thermal/PSU state, infer association from a sensor name, read beyond structure length, clear logs or reboot without approval and recovery.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Platform/power owner supplies and accepts the association/no-device policy; system/workload owner approves reboot and resolves discrepancies. Ordinary pre-reboot read-only collection needs no additional approval.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Owners provide physical topology and reboot authorization. Once supplied, structure-length validation, handle resolution, comparison and approved reboot orchestration can be automated; physical inspection is reserved for disputed topology.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: If reboot, power, thermal/fan or management recovery fails, stop and use approved BMC/OOB recovery. On dangling/wrong/ambiguous references, preserve raw structures and telemetry and do not alter cooling or PSU controls.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Missing topology/policy, unresolved PSU identity, absent-by-length field, dangling/invalid handle, unexplained no-device/shared reference, incomplete data, missing reboot approval/recovery, power/thermal/fan fault, boot/management failure or post-reboot mapping drift.

identified_defects: DeepSeek's grep cannot validate structure-length applicability or resolve the handle to Type 27 and omits reboot persistence.
The source lacks the platform PSU-to-cooling/no-device/shared topology needed to judge correctness.
reason_for_change: No material V2 change is warranted: it already implements the DMTF cross-reference, version/length guard, owner topology, supplemental health evidence and strict no-cooling-write boundary.

new_technical_evidence.title: DMTF DSP0134 SMBIOS Specification
new_technical_evidence.version: 3.9.0; the SUT-implemented version controls exact no-device handling
new_technical_evidence.supports: Type 39 offset 12h is the handle of a Type 27 Cooling Device associated with the power supply; Type 27 represents one cooling device with type/status attributes.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The ODM PSU-to-cooling mapping, shared association and no-device policy are not in the source.

removed_ambiguities: V2 already distinguishes the SMBIOS handle relationship from generic fan telemetry and handles shared/no-device policy through owner input.
resolved_blockers: Missing topology does not prevent safe actual Type 27/39 collection; it gates resolution and PASS only.
remaining_blockers: PASS and reboot remain gated by complete owner topology/version policy, validated package/access, approval and recovery.
objective_improvement_over_v2: None required; KEEP is correct because V2 already converts the handle fragment into a complete version-aware Type 39-to-Type 27 persistence check without manipulating cooling or power hardware.

agent_understanding_result.notes: The isolated validator preserved every Type 39-to-Type 27 Cooling Device Handle relationship or approved no-device representation and did not introduce cooling writes.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: The source checks the SMBIOS Type 39 Cooling Device Handle and requires it to remain correct after reboot.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 adds exactly the missing structure-length check, Type 27 resolution, owner PSU topology and no-write thermal safeguards.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Resolve all applicable Type 39 handles read-only to Type 27 under owner policy, use BMC health only as corroboration and reboot only with stable power/approval/OOB recovery; never change cooling controls.
